{{Spoiler Warning}}

"'''Shattered Fates'''" is a [[Special Mission|Spotlight Mission]] featuring the ''Shattered Glass'' Bots that ran from November 28 to {date}.

== Synopsis ==
'''After "apprehending" Ultra Magnus, things start to get out of hand, as Windblade starts lashing out, the chase continues, and of all things, more mirror versions start to appear cloaked by whatever comes their way!'''

== Changes/Rewards ==
Still the same.
{{Rewards}}

== Transcript ==

=== Chapter 1 - Clotho  ===
====Mission 1 - Thread ====
===== Part 1: =====
'''[[Optimus Prime (MV1)]]''': ''The reappearance of Ultra Magnus should be the cause for celebration, but sadly it only adds more confusion to our battle.''

'''(SG)[[Megatron]]''': ''My deepest condolences Optimus, I can only imagine the inner turmoil you must currently be wrestling with.''

'''Optimus Prime(MV1)''': ''Indeed, until further notice I've placed him under confinement and observation. We have to find a way to clear this planet of duplicates and then we can deal with Magnus.''

'''(SG)[[Starscream]]''': ''We'll figure out a way to open a Space Bridge thingy to our alternate universe and just start herdin' bad bots across!''

'''(SG)Megatron''': ''Let us take a lesson from our polar-opposites and truly combine forces. Amazing how they can oppose us and yet teach us.''

'''(SG)Starscream''': ''To quote the wise and pure Devastator, "We shall heal this world together, and create something beautiful".''

'''Optimus Prime(MV1)''': ''...I am going to need you to stop quoting bots from your world. It overheats my logic-processers. But yes, we should get moving.''

===== Part 2:  =====
'''[[Tantrum]]''': ''Oh, so a buncha' you coming around to call me names too?''

'''(SG)Starscream''': ''I mean if that's what's on the menu! Hey Tantrum, the only Bull you're full of is BULL S--''

'''(SG)Megatron''': ''STARSCREAM! You're not exactly setting a fine example of authority here.''

'''Optimus Prime(MV1)''': ''Who was mocking you, Tantrum?''

'''Tantrum''': ''Big dumb Dino thinks he can slap on a highfalutin Britsh acceny and be all smart.''

'''(SG)Starcream''': ''BRITISH DINO? Oh geeze, oh man, oh gosh, Megatron! Could HE be HERE?''

'''Tantrum''': ''Hey, while y'all are just talking AROUND me like I ain't even here. I think I'mma get some of this anger out by givin' y'all the horns!''

Part 3- 

'''Optimus Prime(MV1)''': ''Who has your circuits all in a tangle?''

'''(SG)Megatron''': ''Long ago I hoped to create soldiers, ones without Embers who ran on pure logic. Sadly I created a monster powered only by a hunger for violence.''

'''(SG)[[Grimlock]]''': ''Ah, thank you for such an abs-o-lutely loverly introduction Megatron. I, Grimlock, am forever in your debt. Wot.''

'''Optimus Prime(MV1)''': ''Your world has...a smart Grimlock?''

'''(SG)Grimlock''': ''Our world 'as a GENIUS GRIMLOCK! Absolutely chuffed to be here. Big plans, all terrible. Speaking of hunger...I, Grimlock, 'ave already made a friend!''

'''[[Kickback]]''': ''I am ready to eat their micro-chips-chips!''

'''(SG)Grimlock''': ''YES! Chip chip, CHEERIO ol' beans!''

'''(SG)Starscream''': '''''BRITISH PEOPLE DON'T EVEN SAY THAT!'''''

====Mission 2 - Spindle ====
===== Part 1:  =====
'''(SG)Grimlock''': ''I, Grimlock, 'ave utilized my magnificent mind to come 'ere, all thanks to my K.I.N.G.!''

'''Optimus Prime(MV1)''': ''And who is your King, Grimlock?''

'''(SG)Grimlock''': ''Yer undone by a simple acronym, 'ow droll.''

''Key Interdimensional Navigation Gadget or K.I.N.G.! It is the device I, Grimlock, 'ave been usin' to bring many of us to this pathetic scrap o' dirt. Wot.''

'''(SG)Starcream''': ''If we get that device we could maybe send everyone back, Boss!''

'''(SG)Megatron''': ''I had the same idea, Starscream. I didn't shout it out loud in front of everyone. But good initiative.''

===== Part 2: =====
'''[[Megatron (ROTF)]]''': ''I see that the Autobots finally have a beast worth taming.''

'''(SG)Megatron''': ''Stay out of this you horrifying carnival reflection!''

'''Megatron(ROTF)''': ''I am struck, wounded, your words cut so deep my dearest doppleganger. I merely wish to woo this Grimlock to safe haven.''

'''(SG)Grimlock''': ''I, Grimlock, was actually 'oping for more of a situation where one was let loose to spread fear and chaos amongst the masses.''

'''Megatron(ROTF)''': ''Also an option, let me clear this trash from your path and we can see what side you join.''

Part 3:

'''(SG)Grimlock)''': ''A perculiar pickle. Sides battlin' so eagerly. Whatever is such a commodity as myself to do? Wot!''

'''(SG)Megatron''': ''You will hand over the interdimensional device, surrender to our care, and join us as we transit back'' home.

'''(SG)Grimlock''': ''Amazin', every word of what you just said was wrong. You shall leave with nothin' ...if you leave at all.''

'''(SG)Starscream''': ''You expect that we aren't going to try to get the K.I.N.G from you?''

'''(SG) Grimlock''': ''No Mr Scream...I, Grimlock, expect you to die!''

=== Chapter 2 - Lachesis  ===
====Mission 1 - Staff ====
===== Part 1: =====
'''[[Marissa Faireborn]]''': ''Windblade, just doing a check in. How is Magnus doing?''

'''[[Windblade]]''': ''The PRISONER who has taken Ultra Magnus' form is stable enough. They won't stop rambling though. Permission to mute them?''

'''Marissa Faireborn''': ''How do you MUTE another Bot?''

'''Windblade''': ''I find that once they're knocked out most everyone gets less talkative.''

'''[[Ultra Magnus]]''': ''Windblade, you must believe me. I am just as confused as everyone else about what is going on.''

'''Windblade''': ''Keep my name out of your speakers. I'm here to guard you not listen to your lies.''

===== Part 2:  =====
'''Marrisa Faireborn''': ''WINDBLADE! Something just triggered every proximity alarm Teletraan has and all surveillance cameras have gone dark.''

'''Windblade''': ''I heard a blast, I think someone is breaking their way into here. Commander, keep an eye on the prisoner.''

'''[[Shockwave]]''': ''You will find that this Commander does not follow the pathetic will of the Autobots. They came here from the flipped dimension with Magnus, isn't that right?''

'''Ultra Magnus''': ''I have no clue what you are speaking of, I swear to you on my maker's circuits!''

'''Shockwave''': ''Enough of the facade you champion of chaos!''

'''Windblade''': ''First I'm going to shut you down Shockwave. Then I'm going to shut down EVERYONE ELSE in this quadrant.''

'''Shockwave''': ''Yes, spend your last precious moments on this world being incorrect. Why make your death any less pitiful than your life?''

Part 3: 

'''Windblade''': ''This still isn't settled. he may be an untrustworthy pile of living malware, but he seemed convinced you two weren't on the level.''

'''Ultra Magnus''': ''I can not remember much, but I know I am an Autobot to my core. Commander, tell Windblade we are trustworthy!''

'''Windblade''': ''...''

''Can't say I'm swayed by that argument. Maybe we should settle this without words.''

====Mission 2 - Scroll ====
===== Part 1: =====
'''Marissa Faireborn''': ''Windblade! Enough! You're here for a purpose and that purposeis not lashing out at the Commander!''

'''Windblade''': ''Yeah well if they're REALLY on our team they sure seemed happy enough to beat me senseless just now''.

'''Marissa Faireborn''': ''There's proof to confirm they're not a duplicate. Autobots in the evil dimension apparently aren't known to let humans stay in one piece for long.''

'''Windblade''': ''Human aren't reowned for their longevity regardless. Can't replace any parts, can barely upgrade, not exactly impressive lifeforms.''

'''Marissa Faireborn''': ''...You know the coms are still open right? Coms with human friends listening?''

'''Windblade''': ''I'm not here to make friends. I'm here to guard possible planetary threats.''

===== Part 2: =====
'''[[Bludgeon]]''': ''I heard that an Autobot has risen from the dead to join the side of glory''

'''Ultra Magnus''': ''For the last time! NO! There is no world in the multiverse where I turn my back on the Autobots.''

'''Windblade''': ''See that's the problem. There are a lot of worlds out there, and Autobot is not a term that universally means good.''

'''Bludgeon''': ''You don't have to grovel in this cage longer brother. You may join the Decepticon cause, it more accurately reflects who you truly are.''

'''Ultra Magnus''': ''This is madness. It is an impossible task to prove to either of you my intents while I sit here to be prodded like a tested rat.''

'''Bludgeon''': ''How right you are, I shall disable the Commander. You make a run for it Magnus!''

Part 3:

'''Windblade''': ''I see you scoping out that Decepticon sized hole in the wall, prisoner. You know what...GO FOR IT. It'd give me an excuse to cut you down as you flee.''

'''Ultra Magnus''': ''You'd stab an Autobot in the back without mercy? You are not the Windblade I once knew.''

'''Windblade''':''' ''I TOLD YOU TO KEEP MY NAME OUT OF YOUR FLITHY MOUTH!'''''

'''Ultra Magnus''': ''I have committed no crime. I have had no trial. I demand to be let out. Freedom is the right of all sentient beings.''

'''Windblade''': ''You dare to twist the words of Prime at a time like this? You disgust me to my deepest core.''

'''Ultra Magnus''': ''My Spark is breaking in two as I raise my weapons...but I cannot stay here any longer and wait for mysteries to solve themselves. Prepare for Battle.''

=== Chapter 3 - Atropos  ===
====Mission 1 - Shears ====
===== Part 1: =====
'''Marissa Faireborn''': ''Commander, Magnus has broken free but there's even more disturbing news. Teletraan found a way to hack the Polarized Autobot feed...you need to hear this!''

'''(SG)[[Optimus Prime]]''': ''Ah, free of that mist of battle! I have arrived to destroy this new Earth!''

'''(SG)[[Ironhide]]''': ''Ain't Earth. Looks like the bridge sent us somewhere a heck of a lot more interestin'.''

'''(SG)Optimus Prime''': ''Ironhide? Is that you? These mirrored form Wheeljack provided are astounding.''

'''(SG)Ironhide''': ''Astounding? I feel ridiculous. Look how much extra metal I'm packing. Flaps on flanges on pistons on parts ... I used to be so streamlined!''

'''(SG)Optimus Prime''': ''Enough of your vanity! What is your report on Project: OMEGA DOOM?''

'''(SG)Ironhide''': ''A few setbacks, thought the change of scenery would help but from what I hear there was a few Bridges sent this way from Paradron.''

'''(SG)Optimus Prime''': ''The prison planet? Fasinating.''

===== Part 2: =====
'''(SG)Starcream''': ''Grimlock's tech is working as expected! The Space Bridges dumped a buncha'  Autojerks here!''

'''Optimus Prime(MV1)''': ''Easy on the insults, Starscream. Some of us still wear the Autobot name with pride.''

'''(SG)Optimus Prime''': ''I should rip that emblem from your corpse! Only We have the right to be called by the name AUTOBOT.''

'''(SG)Megatron''': ''So, Prime, just as you copied my technology to shift forms you follow the others to this world.''

'''(SG)Ironhide''': ''Oh I have been waiting to spill some Decepticon lubricant into the dirt and he looks ready to pop''.

'''(SG)Optimus Prime''': ''If it amuses you and sliences this stupidity, strike them down and show them what a real Autobot looks like.''

Part 3: 

'''(SG)Starscream''': ''If they are still sending Bots down here, I have an idea. I may be able to use the K.I.N.G. to get us some backup.''

'''(SG)Megatron''': ''I dislike the concept of further flooding this planet with Bots, but I do not see many alternatives.''

'''(SG)Bumblebee''': ''Oh I have a lot of options ready. Rip your head off, Rip your arms off, Rip your EMBER OUT!''

'''(SG)Starscream''': ''There's not a lot of variety in your choices there Bumble-brat.''

'''Optimus Prime(MV1)''': ''Perhaps in place of taunting the crazed copy, you can communicate with our friends?''

'''(SG)Optimus Prime''': ''You have no friends here you hollow shell of a Pretender. Bumblebee, show them your sting!''

'''(SG)Bumblebee''': ''Fine! But only because I wanted to not because you said to!''

====Mission 2 - Snipped ====
===== Part 1:  =====
'''(SG)[[Soundwave]]''': ''MEGATRON! STARCSREAM! I got your radical response and rocked down to the Space Bridge avenue!''

'''Optimus Prime(MV1)''': ''I require several explanations.''

'''(SG)Soundwave''': ''Apologies abound my most righteous of rulers! I saw that we were color swappin' with our evil other us-ses so I thought I'd look the part!''

'''(SG)Megatron''': ''Very wise Soundwave! It is good to see you friend, are you ready to round up some Autobots?''

'''(SG)Soundwave''': ''You know I am, Boss! Ravage get out here! You can haz Auto-burgers.''

===== Part 2: =====
'''(SG)Starscream''': ''The bridge is open at the end of the path, if we can push enough of them over it a chain quantum-reaction should start dragging polarized Bots across automatically.''

'''Optimus Prime(MV1)''': ''Is there science to back that up?''

'''(SG)Soundwave''': ''He said QUANTUM didn't he? That's like peak science, my dude.''

'''Optimus Prime(MV1): '''''My...dude?''

'''(SG)Ratchet''': ''Ah one last surgical strike on this merry band of misfits.''

'''(SG)Soundwave: '''''We're starting BAND, Bros? I have no mouth...yet I must ROCK!''

Part 3:

'''(SG)Optimus Pirme''': ''You can try and remove us from this world. But what of the mysteries left behind? Do they not claw at you?''

'''Optimus Prime(MV1)''': ''They haunt me, yes. We shall tie up the loose ends in time. Your continued presence on this world is a threat to the very fabric of our reality.''

'''(SG)Optimus Pirme: '''''I know one who spoke like you...Nemesis Prime.''

'''Optimus Prime(MV1): '''''There is a polar opposite Nemesis Prime. A dark shadow of your own dark shadow?''

'''(SG)Optimus Pirme: '''''He is a meddling spirit of pure light seeking to unite all timelines. An angelic fool.''

'''(SG)Megatron''': ''OPTIMUS! COMMANDER! This is the final push! No matter how this ends, I have been and always shall be your friend!''

'''(SG)Optimus Pirme: '''''Enough of your popping pleasantries! AUTOBOTS! DESTROY!''

'''Optimus Prime(MV1): '''''We have lost too much to turn back now. AUTOBOTS! ROLL OUT!''
